source_units.L120: A genetic study was carried out in 46 positive index cases relatives: 24 were carriers and 22 non-carriers. Out of those 24 carriers, 14 showed HCM, 4 with suggestive electrocardiographic alterations but not HCM diagnostic (H73-II:6 = D75N H197-III:4 = R502Q, H76-II:7 = K504del and H160-IV:2 = P955fs,)], and 6 women, ages 25 (H279-III:2 = V471E), 29 (H95-III:6 = E1179K), 32 (H95-III:2 = E1179K), 33(H131-IV:4 = IVS29+5G>A), 49 (H46-III:4 = K504del) and 68 (H73-II:7 = D75N), were healthy carriers. Within those 22 non-carriers, 18 were considered healthy, 1 with sugestive electrocardiographic alterations (H73-II:3 = D75N), 2 probably affected (H49-IV:1 & IV:5 = R1022P) and 1 case presented HCM (H153-II:1 = E542Q).
